Receive, issue, and transfer stock — low stock and recent bookings below

How booking works

Three short steps — then low stock and recent bookings appear below.

  1. 1. Create items and locations

    Items need a SKU. Locations are warehouses, vans, or site boxes. Favourites speed later booking.

    Open Items

  2. 2. Receive stock

    Scan or pick an item and location, enter the quantity, and confirm. That starts the ledger.

  3. 3. Issue or transfer as needed

    Field users issue from vans. Transfer moves stock between locations. Every booking lands under Recent movements.

Negative balances

Negative stock is turned off. Set each line to zero to clear it.
